afterImage.name: Milestone Equipment Holdings, LLC
afterImage.description: Milestone Equipment Holdings, LLC is a U.S. transportation-equipment leasing platform that owns and manages trailers and 53-foot containers and provides mobile-storage and fleet services under term lease and rental contracts. Headquartered in St. Charles, Missouri, the continuing platform operates through more than 30 U.S. locations following the 2026 sale of Milestone Chassis. Partners Group completed a co-control investment on September 24, 2021 alongside Barings, which had succeeded Wood Creek as sponsor in 2016. Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and Wood Creek are preserved as former owners. Affiliates, legacy businesses, branches, fleets, pools and financing SPVs are not separate PortCos. No later parent-company sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
